reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Formation of street railroad company and articles of association
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5315, A.L. 1947 V. I p. 234). Authorizes five or more persons to form street railroad company and prescribes required contents of articles of association, including duration, route, capital stock, 5 to 13 directors, and subscriber signatures.

headings.title: Subscription thresholds, director affidavit, recording, and fees
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Requires half capital stock subscribed and 10% cash paid with director affidavit, recording with local recorder of deeds, filing with secretary of state, and payment of statutory capital stock fees to director of revenue.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5315, A.L. 1947 V. I p. 234). Confirmed draft titles for street railroad incorporation/articles (5–13 directors) and 50% subscription/10% payment, recording, filing, and capital stock fees.

headings.title: Division orders prescribing transfer rules and single-fare service
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5623; 226.008 transfer note). Authorizes division after hearing to prescribe reasonable transfer regulations, single fare travel distances, successive transfer limits, and prompt transfer use.

headings.title: Street railroad duty to comply with division transfer orders
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Mandates street railroad corporations obey and secure employee observance of every division transfer order served upon company.

headings.title: Single fare continuous trip and transfer issuance under contract
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3. Requires street surface railroads under joint contract to provide continuous trips for single fare and issue transfers without extra charge to promote public convenience.

headings.title: Forfeiture penalty for transfer refusal and municipal boundary limit
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4. Imposes one hundred dollar forfeiture for transfer refusal ($50 to aggrieved passenger and $50 to state public school fund), restricting subsection 3 to railroads wholly within single city or village.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5623; § 226.008 transfer note). Confirmed all 4 draft titles for division transfer orders, carrier obedience duty, joint-contract single-fare continuous trips/transfers, and $100 forfeiture ($50 passenger/$50 school fund) within a single city or village.
